record.notes: Version v1.0-202609, released on 15 Sept 2026 with notice 网安秘字〔2026〕118号 together with sector guides for education, health, and radio, TV and network audiovisual services, to address new risks from the fast spread of AI applications. An organisation applying AI in a sector follows this guide and the sector document. The five security grades run from low to especially major security risk, and each party involved must reach a capability maturity level no lower than the application's grade; for grading and maturity assessment the guide refers to national standards on AI application security classification and grading and on AI security capability maturity assessment. Normative references include GB/T 45654-2025 (CN-10), GB 45438-2025 (CN-08), GB/T 45674-2025 (CN-24), GB/T 45652-2025 and TC260-005, AI Application Ethics Security Guidelines 1.0. Because responsibility for AI failures is hard to assign, it encourages arrangements in applications involving personal safety for immediate, unconditional humanitarian relief after major personal-injury accidents.

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026. Stored and read: the guide's PDF (tc260.org.cn, version v1.0-202609, copy of 14 Oct 2026, unchanged when the archiver checked it on 18 Oct 2026), which gives the number TC260-PG-20268A, the issuer, the month of release (2026 年 09 月) and the contents; and the release notice 网安秘字〔2026〕118号 of 15 Sept 2026 with the four guides attached (tc260.org.cn, the record's secondary source, stored on 18 Oct 2026), which gives the day of release. Stored as the record's secondary source, the notice counts only as alt-official evidence for the date, so the record is at level B; version 1 rested the date on the same notice stored as an official source in run 2026-10-14-discover-leads-2026-10-14, a file that is not among this record's stored files. The summary follows the Chinese text. No English version was found.
